panel.title: Riseup VPN
panel.vpnOn: Tunnel is up. Turning it off leaves the kill switch as it is.
panel.vpnOff: Tunnel is down. Turning it on also turns the kill switch on.
panel.ksOn: On. Only tun0, local networks, and connections already open can send traffic.
panel.ksOff: Off. Traffic can leave outside the tunnel.
panel.ksUnknown: Not readable yet. When it is on, only tun0 and local networks can send new traffic.
panel.blocked: Kill switch is on and the VPN is down, so the internet is blocked. Local networks still work.
panel.leak: VPN is up and the kill switch is off, so traffic can bypass the tunnel.
panel.setupHint: Toggles need a one-time helper. It asks for your password in a terminal, then this bar can switch the VPN and the kill switch without asking again.
panel.stale: The installed helper is older than this plugin. Run setup again.
panel.coupling: Connecting runs the kill switch. Disconnecting does not turn it off.
error.notInstalled: Passwordless helper is not installed yet.
